measuredSpectrum.source: Verro et al. (2022), A&A 660, A34 (X-Shooter Spectral Library DR3); VizieR J/A+A/660/A34, star X0036 (Betelgeuse), merged spectrum without slit-loss correction
measuredSpectrum.note: VLT/X-shooter spectrum taken 2009-10-12, ten years before the Great Dimming. It is not corrected for slit losses, which can tilt the overall shape; Kiehling (1987, VizieR III/124, HR 2061) gives a close colour from an independent scan.

crossCheck.source: Kiehling (1987), HR 2061: an independent ground-based scan
